environment.description: Kafka consumer deployed as an ECS Fargate task in a shared VPC. The Kafka cluster (MSK) has SASL/SCRAM authentication but the audit-events topic has an ACL allowing produce from any principal in the VPC CIDR. Logs are shipped to CloudWatch Logs via the awslogs driver. Any service in the VPC can produce messages to the audit-events topic. No input sanitization layer exists between producers and this consumer. CloudWatch Logs Insights queries are used by the SOC team for alerting, and log-based metric filters trigger SNS notifications for patterns matching 'ERROR' or specific user IDs.

config.kafka_auth: SASL/SCRAM with broad VPC-level produce ACL
config.network: shared VPC with multiple tenant services
config.log_consumers: CloudWatch Metric Filters, Logs Insights dashboards, SNS alerting
